gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.083164 38.729531)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.083164 38.729531)',4326)::geography,
        2300
      )
  AND leisure = 'park';

WITH park_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('[1].geo_wkt'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
university_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('[3].geo_wkt'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffer_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(university_geom.geom::geometry, 2300) AS geom
  FROM university_geom
),
clipped_raster AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, buffer_geom.geom) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us, buffer_geom
  WHERE ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, buffer_geom.geom)
),
park_elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_ValueCount(clipped_raster.rast, true) AS elevation_stats
  FROM clipped_raster, park_geom
  WHERE ST_Intersects(clipped_raster.rast, park_geom.geom::geometry)
)
SELECT 
  2300 AS distance_meters,
  (SELECT json_agg(elevation_stats) FROM park_elevation_stats) AS elevation_stats;
